title_ar: المهمة الأولى: من الإقلاع إلى البوابة
title_en: First mission: boot to the gate (current freeze)
notes: Opening movies: no pad. wait_movie_end watches [sf-movie] PlayerStart/Stop.
In-engine story cutscenes often have no [sf-movie] line — those steps use pad:none and a wait. If unsure, do not press.
Teleport slots are empty until TELEPORT_SAVE fills checkpoints.json (only X=6499.8 is known, Y/Z missing).
The PC port still freezes at the gate before later story movies. The route stops there and reports.
PAD sequences live under sequences/ and also /workspace/sf-shared/replay/sequences/.

steps.note: boot_to_start.padseq itself waits for movie end, then presses START. The tester must not send any other press until that wait succeeds.
